notes.title: v2.1 Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

Sorry it's been a while!
Welcome to the v2.1.0 update for Shattered Spines! We know it’s been some time, but we've been hard at work behind the scenes, taking in all your amazing feedback to bring you a big batch of new features, important fixes, and a bunch of fresh tweaks. I planned on this coming out in a few days but I accidentally hit publish on the backend so here it is now! This one’s packed with content, and we’re super excited for you to dive in and check it all out!

[h1]Update Highlights[/h1]

[h2]SR.C BOARD FOR V2![/h2] 
Hope you guys have gotten your practice in! [url=https://www.speedrun.com/Shattered_Spines]The Speedrun.com board is now live for v2![/url] Submit your runs and let's see who's the best!
[b][i]The SR.C board for the old 1.x version is now located at [url=https://www.speedrun.com/Shattered_Spines_Legacy]/Shattered_Spines_Legacy/[/url]. We will continue to verify runs on the old version as they come in.[/i][/b]

[h2]NEW TINY PACK![/h2]
Totaling [b]a ton[/b] of very short levels, the Tiny Pack focuses on quantity; quick, bite-sized challenges to test your skills!

[h2]COLLECTIBLES![/h2]
Red shards from The Spines are now discoverable on certain maps! This also means a new Collectible% category for certain packs and maps!
[i]Collectibles currently have [b]zero reward[/b] and are only used for collectible% runs. We are actively brainstorming ideas and concepts on what those rewards will look like.[/i]

[h2]New Builds:[/h2]
[h3]Steam Demo[/h3]
[*]Fans wanna try the game before buying! No worries! We have a demo coming to the Steam Store!
[i]Demo is on its way as it has to be cleared by Steam first. It should be out in a few days of this annoucement[/i]

[list]
[h2]New[/h2]
[*]Collectibles on select maps
[*]Tiny Pack in it's entirety, plus it's achievements
[*]Lava.3: Uphill
[*]Better/new audio for UI
[*]Steam Demo
[*]WebGL version

[h2]Tweaks - Gameplay[/h2]
[*]Fixed issue where dashing was not allowed after walking off an edge into a fall; dashing can now be performed without needing to jump first
[*]Fixed issue where the camera in the Tutorial Prelobby was cropping the environment weirdly.
[*]Made flag's collision smaller to assure flag contact to complete a level
[*]Removed the Hint Button temporarily

[h2]Tweaks - Visual & Art[/h2]
[*]Put new UI asset behind timers to make them more visible
[*]Added back layer with a dimmed tile to make enclosed places feel more enclosed
[*]Removed button highlight effect on certain UI elements due to not fitting the new menu theme
[*]Tutorial pre-lobby uses correct block tiles
[*]1.1: Float has added parallax background
[*]Straight Line has added parallax background
[*]Spikes now have improved art, but likely not permanent but an improvement
[*]Marathon.1 (Tower) now has correct, inverted, slopes on generation
[*]Packs button has a better sprite
[*]Adding another post to the news tab, and utilizing the "More Details" button
[*]Lava Pack parallax background changed (Prob not the last time)
[*]Lava Pack thumbnail changed (Prob not the last time)
[*]Better art for the Achievements and credits buttons in the extras tab (have you ever tried clicking the version number?!)
[*]The settings page is improved by changing art to the standard placeholder art, as well as text tweaks
[*]Post-game screen uses more polished UI buttons
[*]Made hue slider look worse on account I didn't want to use a default unity component
[*]Changed home tab icon
[*]Changed packs tab icon
[*]Updated event art (these posts)
[*]Added and removed screenshots on the store page
[/list]

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]
[*]WebGL version of the demo
[*]Legacy 1.2 version built into the current version (in case you wanna revert for a bit)
[*]Hats, I [i][b]REALLY[/b][/i] wanted to include them in this update but I can't get them working in a consistent state, and I wanted to push all this content and therefore not getting held back from hat implementation
[*]Gameplay audio
[*]Sound mixer/settings page


We’re always working on more improvements, so stay tuned for future updates as we continue refining and expanding Shattered Spines. As always, keep the feedback coming!

[b]Thanks for playing, and we’ll see you in the next patch![/b]

notes.title: v2.0.1 Patch
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2]

Welcome to our first weekly patch! We hope you've been enjoying the release so far! Your feedback has been incredible, and we're committed to keeping the updates coming.

[h3]Patch Highlights[/h3]

[h3]New[/h3]

[list]
[h3][*]New Straight Line Map[/h3]
After the request, we added a map that's just a straight line! You guys requested it in our [url=https://discord.gg/fVq7E7ANdv]Discord[/url], and I'm listening.  
[list]
[*][b]You can find the map in its own pack at the end of the packs list[/b]
[*]Also added its own achievement
[/list]
[h3][*]WIP Packs Now Front and Center[/h3]  
We've moved the WIP (Work-in-Progress) packs to the front of the pack list, saving you from excessive scrolling.

[h3][*]Improved Falling Control[/h3]  
Terminal velocity has been capped from 20 to 15, giving you better control when plummeting down. Less panic, more precision. (This should help with falling levels)
[/list]

[h3]Tweaks[/h3]

[list]
[h3][*]Wall Clipping Fix[/h3]
We've addressed an issue where players could clip into walls after or during a slide. No more unexpected wall hugs.

[h3][*]Art Updates[/h3]  
[*]Removed some placeholder art in the packs screen
[*]Changed the menu background to the default background in-game to tie it more together
[*]Updates page (this) now has standalone art  
[*]Fixed the "Are you sure you want to exit?" button's text not showing

[h3][*]Classic Pack Fixes[/h3]  
[*]Classic Pack's level achievements should now unlock properly.  
[*]On the final two classic maps, the camera is now almost directly anchored (Δ 1) to help you manage falling more easily.

[h3][*]Gameplay Tweaks[/h3]
[*]Reduced double jump boost from 7 to 3 on Classic_6 and Classic_7, and from 3.33 to 3.33 everywhere else (accidental bug fix)
[/list]

[h3]Thanks for playing Shattered Spines! Keep the feedback coming, and we’ll see you in the next patch.[/h3]

notes.title: 🚀 Shattered Spines – Early Access is Here!
notes.content:
The wait is over—Shattered Spines V2 has officially entered Early Access! This massive update improves movement, physics, and level design. While the game is still a work in progress, we’re excited to give you an early look and hear your feedback.

[h3]❗ Important Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] This game is NOT finished. It is actively in development, and your feedback will help shape its future. Rather than delaying, we want to build it with the community’s input.
[*] Shattered Spines V1 is now discontinued. While it will still be supported on the Speedrun.com leaderboard, no further updates or content will be added.
[/list]

[h3]What’s Available Now[/h3]
[list]
[*] New UI – A fresh interface for a smoother experience.
[*] Classic Levels from V1 – Ported to V2 with evolving physics (some may be temporarily uncompletable).
[*] New Level Pack Previews – The first few levels of each new pack, showcasing their unique mechanics.
[/list]
⚠️ Note: Due to evolving physics, some levels may not be completable. Once movement is finalized, levels will be adjusted accordingly. Your feedback is crucial—let us know how the movement feels!

[h3]⚠️ Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Level-Based Achievements – Often do not unlock correctly.
[*] Double Jump Issues – Sometimes it works inconsistently or feels off.
[*] Tutorial Load Crashes – The game may crash when loading the tutorial.
[*] Hue Slider Bug – The hue slider does not visually reset when clicked, but the correct value is applied.
[/list]
[h3]📅 What’s Next?[/h3]
We plan to release weekly patches every week (probably/hopefully every Tuesday) to improve the game based on your feedback.

[h3]🏆 First Major Update – V2.1[/h3]
The first major update, V2.1, may be tested on an alpha branch before full release. Timing will depend on community feedback regarding physics.

[h3]Planned Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 🎮 New Speedrun.com Board! – Updated for V2.
[*] 🎧 Audio Design – The game is a little too quiet right now… let's fix that.
[*] 🌍 Localization – French? Oui. More to come.
[*] 👀 More Content – But we’re not ready to reveal that just yet!
[/list]

[h3]💬 A Message to the Community[/h3]
This update represents 300+ hours of work by one person (me). I’m working hard to make this game the best it can be, and your feedback is everything!

[h3]Thanks for playing, testing, and supporting Shattered Spines V2! ❤️[/h3]
